title: kt-null-graph-controls: code and run files for "When does a concept graph help a knowledge tracer? Null-graph controls by entry point for KC-level first attempts"
description:
Code, run files and analysis scripts for the manuscript "When Does a Concept Graph Help a Knowledge Tracer? Null-Graph Controls by Entry Point for KC-Level First Attempts" (H. B. Truong, prepared for IEEE Transactions on Learning Technologies).

The study fixes a KC-level probe tracer and measures a concept graph against an empty-graph control that keeps every other parameter, a ladder of null graphs, fixed random codes and capacity controls on ten public corpora, with a replication on two held-out corpora under a pre-specified plan. Every run file, analysis output and script behind the tables and figures of the manuscript and its Supplementary Material is under kt/; unit tests in tests/.

Version 4.0.0 was the first release of this code as a repository of its own: a copy of the directory kt/ of an earlier repository (releases 2.0.0 to 3.14.0), without its commit history. Version 4.1.0 adds reference points for the agreement of next-KC choices (kt/src/r18_decision_agreement.py) and an inventory of every run file (kt/src/r18_run_sets.py, kt/results_r18/run_manifest.csv); no new runs and no changed results.
